// Code generated by ESS. DO NOT EDIT.
package __PACKAGE__

import (
	"encoding/base64"
	"encoding/json"
	"github.com/go-json-experiment/json/jsontext"
	"unicode/utf8"
)

// NormalizeBase64JSON decodes canonical standard base64 and UTF-8, then normalizes unchanged JSON bytes.
func (n *Normalizer) NormalizeBase64JSON(branch string, encoded string) (json.RawMessage, error) {
	data, err := base64.StdEncoding.Strict().DecodeString(encoded)
	if err != nil || base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(data) != encoded {
		return nil, refusal("/input", "input_base64", "expected canonical standard base64")
	}
	if !utf8.Valid(data) {
		return nil, refusal("/input", "input_utf8", "retained JSON bytes must be UTF-8")
	}
	return n.Normalize(branch, data)
}

func captureJSON(data []byte, at string, depth int) (string, error) {
	if err := validateCaptured(data, at, depth); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	return base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(data), nil
}

// Grammar and token spans come from jsontext; only Unicode and depth are checked
// here. Values and object keys are visited in source order without numeric parsing.
func validateCaptured(data []byte, at string, depth int) error {
	if depth > 64 {
		return refusal(at, "input_depth", "JSON input exceeds 64 levels")
	}
	invalid := func() error { return refusal(at, "input_syntax", "captured JSON token contains invalid Unicode") }
	decoder := rawDecoder(data)
	switch data[0] {
	case '{':
		_, _ = decoder.ReadToken()
		for decoder.PeekKind() != '}' {
			key, err := decoder.ReadValue()
			if err != nil || !key.IsValid() {
				return invalid()
			}
			raw, err := decoder.ReadValue()
			if err != nil {
				return invalid()
			}
			if err := validateCaptured(raw, at, depth+1); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
	case '[':
		_, _ = decoder.ReadToken()
		for decoder.PeekKind() != ']' {
			raw, err := decoder.ReadValue()
			if err != nil {
				return invalid()
			}
			if err := validateCaptured(raw, at, depth+1); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
	case '"':
		if !jsontext.Value(data).IsValid() {
			return invalid()
		}
	}
	return nil
}
